LanguageData.Gun_PPS-43_RWP.description: A compact submachine gun from the mid-20th century, the PPS-43 is known for its reliability and simplicity. Offering moderate accuracy and a high rate of fire, it's ideal for close-quarters combat against multiple targets. Low recoil makes it easy to handle, but its stopping power is limited compared to modern firearms.
